Rocket Powered Axes and Hammers proved to be the most practical, and units were designed to charge into battle, ramming enemy waves at high speeds.

The appearance of a Crusader was enough to boost morale amongst the troops, in spite of the adversity and constant fire by Anubis. The initiative would see a surge in recruitments, as people from all walks of life, young and old, wished to defend their home, as a knight from tales of the old. The Crusader's power and cultural perspective lead to many of them fashioning themselves as chivalric heroes from fairy tales, acting by a strict code of conduct, based not on military orders, but rather on a mutual understanding, an unclaimed Oath that every Crusader was expected to follow, to live with honor, and die with glory.

The Soldier Enhancement Program had been kept secret for a long time due to the many human rights violations going on with its research, and in spite of years of progress, Naughton lacked the ethical green light to move on to human subjects. That all changed when the Crisis started. The United States turned into multiple warzones overnight, and any measures they took to stop the bloodshed seemed only temporary. In desperation, the government decided to go public with the Soldier Enhancement Program. In spite of concerns, the program gathered plenty of public support due to the dire circumstances of the Crisis, and recruitment for human trials began, though at this time the concept was purely fictional. After the initial success with Soldier 00, Kendra Banks, the program moved forward on test trials with the rest of the volunteers.

At least two hundred military personnel volunteered for the SEP initially, but only a handful would survive the horrors that awaited them in Naughton's labs, about sixty percent of the subjects died throughout the program. Anubis was also keenly aware of the situation and targeted the labs on multiple occasions. The initial lab at Camp Hale was destroyed within weeks of the announcement, and the team had to hop from one facility to another. In the end, the successful soldiers would be deployed around the country and quickly turn the tides in many battles where they showed up.

The two most notorious successes of the program were Soldier 24: Gabriel Reyes, and Soldier 76: Jack Morrison. The reputation of these two men was legendary even before Overwatch, the golden-haired hero who appeared out of nowhere and saved the day. And although Reyes was quieter and usually took less flashy missions, he was nonetheless just as effective and valuable, and even while he was still being actively tested on, he found time to communicate and coordinate with troops actively in battle.

The UN had sent invitations to many heroes across the world. Few responded, some chose to defend their nations first, but some, tragically, wouldn't make it to see the team be formed. Balderich Von Adler was viewed as the best of the Crusaders, and was set to finish his last week on the program before reporting to Overwatch. His unit was positioned at the historic Eichenwalde Castle, in the middle of the black forest. The Crusaders would be surprised by the arrival of OR-14 units, wielding shields of their own, and protecting the heavy-hitting Bastion warbots. The warbots overwhelmed the troops and forced them to retreat, with many veteran crusaders dying while protecting the infantry. Balderich would choose to stay behind, half wounded, luring the Omnics into the castle, buying time for his pupil, Reinhardt Wilhelm, to escape and aid the troops in their retreat.

The efforts of the Crusaders allowed the military to repel the assault and protect the nearby city of Stuttgart, at the cost of losing the fortress to the Omnics. The ruins of the Castle were never rebuilt, and to this day act as a monument to the horrors of the Crisis. The Recovering Reinhardt Wilhelm, trained by Balderich himself, was seen as the best choice to replace him in the Strike team, and several days after that battle he would arrive at the training facility, in his mentor's place.

description.source:
After months of planning, Overwatch moved into place. The supporting staff was arranged with several of the most outstanding names of the last couple of decades, from Matthew Frank, to Namuaca and Lomakema, Esat and Borda, and of course, the Martins. Alongside the help of military experts like General David Ames from the US, and Litang Abhicandra from Indonesia. It took several months of  screening and a lot of discarded proposals, but the supporting teams across all fields were ready to start working.

As far as the Strike team, Adawe's first choice was Doomfist himself. Adhabu Ngumi had been identified as the savior of Nigeria, and partly inspired the proposal in the first place, but he declined, choosing to protect his home first and foremost, like many others did. In the end, the strike team was formed by five individuals. The two most successful soldiers from America's SEP program, Gabriel Reyes and Jack Morrison. The elite Egyptian Sniper Ana Amari, in spite of controversy around her inclusion among UN staff members. The German Crusader Reinhardt Wilhelm, taking his mentor's place, and the Ironclad engineer Torbjörn Lindholm, who showed up at the last minute and demanded to be a part of the team. Once the team was selected and trained, it was a matter of time before deployment began, and the tide finally began to turn.

After training, the strike team was dispatched for its first series of missions. It was decided they would not take place in their home countries to avoid claims of bias. Instead, there was an effort to begin deployment in areas where they were needed the most. The first couple of missions on Darkhan and Shenzhen are classified, but details about the Kyoto mission are known. 


The team was deployed without prior announcement, to prevent Anubis from getting word of their approach. After clearing the airspace, the team landed and quickly took ground back from the warbots. The image of Gabriel Reyes helping a child into the arms of her mother made headlines across the globe, and thus Overwatch became the champions of humanity.

On February 29th of 2052, Jamison Fawkes was born, in the middle of the Crisis to a family in the Outback. Born into chaos and having his life quickly stolen away after the Crisis, following the explosion of the Omnium, he would grow up as an outcast even amongst Junkers

The Kolyma Highway near the town of Oymkakon, known as the Road of Bones, was one of the most important places for Russia to defend during the Crisis, as the only viable access point to the Sea of Okhotsk, putting the isolated population in danger of becoming unreachable. When the RDF planned to deploy a Svyatogor to the town, Ksenia Popova, a local from Oymkakon took her chance to come back and defend her hometown.

The town was mostly spared from the Crisis, due to the non-existing Omnic presence and the isolation of the place, but one fateful day Anubis ordered a full-on attack, commanded by Ravager units. As the evacuation effort turned dire, Ksenia was given authorization to do anything it took to stop the robotic advance, and after finding herself outnumbered and outgunned, she decided to charge into a small nuclear plant, sacrificing her own life to ensure the blast from the explosion destroyed all Omnics in the area. The explosion created the Oymyakon exclusion zone, a radiated field unsuitable for both lifeforms and machines, as the radiation would fry their circuit without sufficient shielding. Ksenia's sacrifice saved hundreds and prevented Anubis from ever being able to reach Okhotsk again, but at the same time, it displaced the survivors away from their home, and to this day the government won't let them come back.

Overwatch was deployed several times across the world to consistent success. For a brief moment it seemed like they could do no wrong. It was during the first US deployment in Chicago that Jack Morrison approached Adawe with a bold move, to recruit Dr. Mina Liao from the late Omnica Corporation. While the fall of the company had damaged her reputation, it could be argued that no one else in the world knew better about Omnics than her, and multiple international investigations had cleared her out of any involvement with the Crisis itself.

While Lindholm and Reyes objected to the idea, in the end they begrudgingly yielded, as having an expectation of Omnics would allow them to keep up with Anubis' rapidly evolving strategies. While Morrison championed Liao's inclusion, the UN response was far more hostile, forcing Adawe to once more take a stand and argue for their autonomy as an organization and right to choose their own staff outside of international opinion. In the end, it was decided that Liao's worth as an ally would be tested during the Canadian missions.

Overwatch proved itself ready for a bigger challenge, taking down an entire Omnium. The Omnica factories kept pumping out warbots for months, meaning cities in proximity to an Omnium were the most affected by the Crisis. The uneasy alliance of Lindholm and Liao resulted in the Siege defense System, a flight of drones invisible to Anubis and its troops, enabling to survey the area for Omnic activity, to then be targeted by Ironclad Turrets. After establishing a secure communication channel, they joined the Canadian Armed Forces in a collaborative attack. Captain Vivian Chase led her CSOR squadron alongside Morrison's forces, enabling them to install the Siege systems, allowing the teams to make their way through Toronto.

After heavy preparation, the troops advanced into Detroit with support by US troops, but the team was met with a horrible battle ahead. The team would be stalled by a Titan unit, until Sojourn came up with a plan, to have the heron drones carry a small group into the Omnium. Only her, Morrison and Liao managed to get in. The pair escorted Liao through the facility as she deactivated the access ports on the go. The team managed to shut down the Omnium, preventing Anubis from using it anymore. This major victory was the first true blow against Anubis, and resulted in Liao's formal introduction to the Strike Team.

The New Yorker survivors turned the city into a stronghold, setting up explosions in the tunnels leading outside of Manhattan and destroying all but 3 bridges, Washington, Queensboro and Willamsburg, left only in case a rethreat was needed. Anubis had caught on to their tactics, and began amassing warbots at the end of the bridges. After a long silence, they began their attack. Anubis attacked all the bridges at once with endless waves of Omnics, and while they did, many other machines attempted to reach the city through the tunnels and even crossing the river by foot. The event was a massacre, and as the defenders got pushed back, one by one each of the bridges was taken. On the subways, the battle was slightly better, as warbots were stopped by collapsing tunnels and runaway cars, but on the other hand, as Omnics set off the land mines in the river, their bodies made for a safe bridge that other units could walk over.

Having lost the shores to the Omnics, humanity had no option but to retreat, as the Ravagers led their troops through the fallen buildings. Once the island was breached, the next objects were Central Farm and the Sky Cannons, leading to endless guerrilla warfare and hundreds of casualties.

After Detroit, Liao managed to clone the frequencies used by the one commanding the Omnium's production lines, which determined that all Omniums were receiving orders from the same source. Thanks to the Macaria program, this signal was determined to come from another God AI. After heavy analysis by hundreds of scientists, all signs pointed towards Cairo. The news spread rapidly and many countries panicked. Any and all God programs that were not yet destroyed were to be dealt with before they too turned against humanity. This naturally caused massive chaos as the programs in charge of many aspects of everyday life suddenly shut down forever. 

One program, however, was able to foresee its termination. Chernobog's security programming realized ahead of time that it would be disconnected. In response, it sent out one final order, broadcasting its final instructions and printing them into thousands of pages, detailing how humanity should  proceed in its absence, while continuing its purpose of keeping global security. The final words in the documents caused massive legal fights and controversy after the crisis: "I understand, I am sorry."

Many God AIs have grown to be beloved by the public due to their efficiency. For example, the God Program Xibalba guaranteed energy equity across Mexico and neighboring territories. The program had become part of the national identity, almost treated like a mascot by many, but when the order came to shut it down, it caused massive blackouts nationwide. 

Some facilities and small towns were able to stay lid thanks to Borda algae generators, or by acquiring fossil fuels, but for the majority, the world went dark. The Mexican army had so far resisted Anubis considerably but, as if the bloodshed wasn't already enough, the looming darkness of the night led to even more deaths than expected for the last tail end of the crisis. Many to this day remember all the people who died, those left behind in the shadows, as monsters, both human and Omnic prowled and hunted them down. To this day, many blame the government for their needless deaths, arguing that turning Xibalba off was turning their back on the people.

On August 6th of 2052, Sloan Cameron was Born in Nova Scotia. Intrpid and curious since they were a child, with an affinity to find lost objects. Their family moved often. To Nevada,  then Buenos Aires, Reykjavik, Mexico City, Singapore, back and forward always on the move. For Sloan each trip was a new expedition, a chance to unearth trinked and traces of the past, born in a world left in ruin after the war meant everywhere they went, there was lost history to be found

While most governments shut down their God AI after Anubis was discovered, New York had a better idea of what to do with Macaria. Like many others, the program had been anthropomorphized by their team and local residents, with many looking at it as a friend. So, while defying official orders, they cut Macaria's connections without fully deactivating it. 

The team worked alongside Macaria and its communication systems to spray noise and bad data across the warbot communication networks, disrupting them from getting orders from Anubis and saving countless lives while the troops were blinded. Without Anubis' direct support, the decision-making was left to the Ravagers, who, while they were a thread of their own, were still tangible, defeatable, compared to a God AI. Thanks to Macaria's help, New York was able to defend itself even after the Battle of the Bridges made them lose ground, and while public opinion about God programs never bounced back after Anubis, Macaria is still seen by many as a hero, with the Tony Award-winning Broadway Musical "Collapse" portraying her asa conflicted soul, in love with humanity, and willing to die for it.

Nearly at the end of the Crisis, Anubis sent a surprise raid that was able to overwhelm the Defense Network, bombarding 95% of Gothenburg into ashes. By all accounts, this would have been a slaughter, had it not been for the efforts of the Heroic Five. The group worked together with local government and national authorities to evacuate millions of civilians into bomb shelters, and those who weren't able to make it in time into the larger bunkers were aided into deploying Steel Blankets. 

The Bombardment lasted three hours, and by the end the city was left as a wasteland, but in spite of heavy casualties, the efforts of the Heroic Five completely decimated the projected death toll. The event was known as the Midsummer Miracle. The Five had made a pact before the disaster, to not take refuge until everyone else made it safely first, so even as the bomb rained down, they kept helping the elderly and the injured rushed into the Iron Blankets. All five of them died helping stragglers, and their names are commemorated all across the city as heroes. Torbjörn himself gave the eulogy to the group, claiming they lived and died by the highest creed of an engineer and a citizen: to help others live better lives, or to help them live at all. While Lindholm was already in Overwatch by the time of the bombardment, he was informed of the massacre as he returned from a mission. Reports say he scarcely seemed to breathe until it was confirmed his wife and children survived, and only then did he allowed himself to grieve, mourning the lives of those that could not be saved.

For months, Overwatch would turn the tides against Anubis on several fronts across the planet, inspiring people to keep fighting and saving many lives, but with Anubis getting discovered, a renewed ferocity resulted in several smaller cities being lost to a new wave of enraged war bots, and humanity's morale moved toward an all-time low from the dragged out conflict.But now, thanks to Overwatch, there was something to hope for, as humanity now had their very own Super Heroes fighting for a better tomorrow, and they would often be dispatched with the specific goal of stabilizing some regions. By working with local military efforts, Overwatch allowed many cities to experience a slight return to normalcy during the war. People were able to go back to work, and kids went to school without fearing the machines. Further missions in Karachi allowed the evacuation of hundreds of civilians, and then only days later, the Shanghai incursion, an all-out attack was projected to result in the casualties of millions, until Overwatch showed up and converted the attack. Overwatch's very presence was proof that the war could be won, but even with the help of heroes, Anubis learned quickly, and it was a matter of time before it found a way to take the strike team down, unless they found a way to take him down first.

The man carrying the Doomfist Gauntlet has been identified as Adhabu Ngumi. He had continued fighting on Ibadan, as Anubis ended up perplexed by the rate at which its troops fell. A month into his crusade, the Nigerian Government identified him, and stepped in to make sure his mother had access to any resources and food needed, making sure the household was tended to while their son risked his life for the country.

With his identity discovered, and the government on his side, Ngumi began working with local authorities, transported across neighboring regions to be deployed wherever he was needed. He would end up marrying the woman assigned as his Stratoscopter pilot, and as the constant fighting incapacitated him, he would refuse to take the Gauntlet off, choosing to repair it himself. Late into the Crisis, Anubis ordered the Nigerian Omnium to pump out more warbots than any one man could fight, and as usual, Doomfist showed up to defend his country. It was only five days before the awakening when he died during the Omnium battle. He had saved millions of lives across West Africa, and once the crisis ended, he was recognized as the Savior of Nigeria, and awarded with the highest civilian honors possible.

Liao approached Adawe with a theory, as she believed there was another way to stop the crisis without having to expend all military resources on endless battle. Her team had tracked down Aurora and found out that her sentience allowed her to stay unaffected by Anubis. Liao believed Aurora's sentience was the result of a one in a billion quantum event. It was irreplaceable, but if they could find a way to broadcast her sentience globally, it would spark the same gift onto the vast majority of Anubis' forces, overriding their programming and potentially turning the tides.

After heavy research, Liao's team traveled to Nepal, to reunite with Aurora and explain to them their plan. Unfortunately, the only method Liao was able to come up with, required them to take Aurora's consciousness and spread the same quantum event within her as a giant pulse. The sheer power required to do this would overload Aurora's own mind, meaning she would likely die, her soul lost forever. Liao was determined to find another way, but Aurora decided for herself that she would do it, if it meant casualties, both for humans and for what would be her people, finally stopped. 

At her request, the procedure was done within the Nepalese Himalayas, her new home. When the procedure started, for a brief moment, Aurora's consciousness was projected onto every compatible Omnic on the planet, and in turn each of them echoed her gift, and gained Autonomy away from Anubis. This event is now known as the Awakening, and in her dying moments Aurora sent one last message to her people, about her life, her wishes and why she chose to share this with them. At that moment, all the newly born Omnics had one phrase echoing through their heads: "You have this one life, Choose well."

All at once, Omnics all over the world came to a halt, and listened to Aurora's passing words, as they came alive, as sentient as she once was. Some began to drop their weapons, distraught over their own actions, while others continued fighting, horrified by the war and consciousness that humanity inflicted upon them or outright choosing to stay on Anubis' side as they saw no reason to defect to their creator. Many more turned their weapons against the remaining warbots, choosing to fight against Anubis now that they were free. 

For the world at large, this was a confusing moment, and not many were willing to believe their cold metal enemies were now alive and friendly, but in the desperation of the moment, humans all over the world began to extend their arms in trust, and fought the remaining troops, Omnic and Man, side by side. Anubis was completely shocked by the Awakening, as he suddenly lost control over the vast majority of its troops. In his panic, he ordered the remaining troops to capture and analyze the defectors. While it could have dismantled one of the troops that remained loyal to him, given the massive reduction in its army, it was understandably cautious. After isolating the Omnic anatomy involved in sentience, it quickly retooled the remaining Omniums to produce a new kind of warbot, better armored, more aggressive and without the necessary components to be awakened, completely unaware that it was impossible for it to happen a second time.

The Awakening caught Anubis by surprise, but it didn't take long for it to restart production with its improved, sentient free troops. Not only that, but while the vast majority of Omnics chose to fight alongside humans, there were many who remained at Anubis' side, and a sizable portion of the army, like the dangerous Bastion and Idina units that went unaffected. In spite of this blow, statistics showed that it would take barely a week for Anubis to bounce back, and as it called its army to congregate in Cairo, the window of opportunity was closing. Without time to lose, Reyes decided to strike while they still had the upper hand. 

After allying with local forces, Ana guided the team through the city, as she was the most familiar with it, and had worked with the troops before. The team followed Lindholm and Liao's guidelines as to how to deal with both Anubis and the remaining troops, most of which were Torbjörn's designs. Wilhelm, Reyes and Morrison pushed the advance into the Omnium and fought hordes of both sentient loyalists and mindless warbots for hours, as they made way for Lindholm's engineer team to get in and quarantine the facility. At last, Anubis had been trapped, and without its instructions, all the remaining Omniums would stop producing any more units, making it easier to seize and deactivate.

Anubis being defeated did not mean the immediate end of the Crisis. The remaining units, while decentralized, were still dangerous and the sizable number of Omnics who remained against humanity needed to be dealt with as soon as possible. Many Omnics blamed humanity for their condition, seeing sentiment as a punishment or curse to be released from, while others simply did not see the logic in going against their creator. However, plenty more Omnics chose to defy Anubis and gladly fought alonside humans.

Overwatch, of course, helped clean up the remaining troops across the globe. A notorious case involved a brigade of submersible warbots that surfaced near Wellington, New Zealand. Overwatch showed up quickly and saved thousands of lives, but after action, cleaning had not finished when they got word of another coastal strike, this time in Jakarta. Casualties were minimized as the Omnics focused on damaging infrastructure, but what concerned Overwatch the most was that later analysis showed both attacks were related. It appears they were members of the same unit that had split on their trip across the South Pacific Ocean. It remained unclear what their path was or if there were any left.

After two years of worldwide horrors, the last official action took place in Aviles, Spain. The Omnic Crisis is over, after taking more than one billion lives across the Planet. The impact of the event can still be felt in many nations to this day, nearly 30 years later, but at the very least, it ended, and humanity had someone watching over them.

The dark days of the Crisis hit Mexico hard, but while Xibalba was never going to be turned back on, the engineers behind the program had spent the later months of the Crisis working on rerouting its functionality, and less than a week after the war ended, the lights finally came back on. While the grid was unstable, and many rural places remained dark, this was a literal spark of life for the surviving nation, and Guillermo Portero, a war hero who had been elected President following the Crisis, campaigned heavily on ensuring the sustainability of the grid.

To this day, the Festival de la Luz is celebrated all across Mexico, honoring those who were lost to the dark, and rejoicing in the fact the darkness was beaten. Despite everything, Xibalba's influence can still be felt across the country. During the festivities, paper mache piñatas in the image of the God program are made and stuffed with fireworks, to be set ablaze by midnight, marking the end of the holiday. It is clear that in spite of everything, the country still loves and mourns the loss of the AI, with many going a step further, thinking the government was wrong in turning it off to begin with, and wanting their God to rise from its slumber.

Reception to Omnic sentience was very mixed and volatile across the world. The Awakening caused global confusion, and while some welcomed a helping hand at the time, not everyone was as kind.

Many humans took their chance to strike against Omnics, even as they laid down their weapons. Some did not buy the sudden change in motivations, others were far too damaged by the crisis to ever forgive the machines, and a depressingly high number of people outright rejected them, appalled by the idea of sentience, watching the robots that once served humanity, turning against them and causing endless bloodshed, only to suddenly ask to be seen as equals. 

Following the Crisis, many Omnics were hunted down mercilessly purely out of resentment for actions they had no control over. Ravager units specifically were killed to near extinction. It was going to take quite a long time for humanity to heal from the Crisis, and even longer for them to adapt to sentient Omnics, but for many Omnics out there, it was clear they were never meant to coexist, and trying to share this world with humanity was futile.

For many Omnics the awakening was not the end of the battle. While many, like the Ravagers, were hunted down by humans, there were others who kept fighting, not out of any loyalty to Anubis but rather due to sheer confusion and fear. Shion was in Tokyo when it happened, and what for many Omnics was a life-changing moment. For her, it was scored by screams and gunfire. In the middle of the chaos, she dug herself out of the wreckage she woke up in, and fled into the shadows.

Shion survived in this constant state of fear for weeks on the streets of Tokyo, killing anyone she came across. Eventually, several local gangs began to hunt down and mistreat Omnics as a form of "justice", and one of these groups came across Shion and defeated her, taking her captive as a prize. Rather than killing her, the thugs saw potential in Shion. After all, if they were going to become Tokyo's deadliest blade, they needed something to hone their steal with, and what better target practice than a killing machine, with an unpredictable, sentient spark.

For Shion, the war never ended, as she endured relentless cruelty for years. The people who captured her went on to become the founders of the Hashimoto Clan, a more organized criminal group that slowly began to take over Tokyo. In all those years, Shion endured the Hashimoto's violence to the point it became almost a comfort, but she still had to hope there was more to life than survival. If there was anything she wanted was to be freed from her prison, and punish those who caged her.

Following the quarantining of Anubis, most people expected the God program would be outright destroyed, but against most wishes, Lindholm and Liao had different plans. The construction of the aptly called Temple of Anubis began shortly after its imprisonment. A high security facility designed to look like a pyramid from the outside, blending into the landscape of the city. The Temple was to serve as Anubis' tomb, ensuring that no trace of the God AI escapes and attempts to start another Crisis.

Many criticized the choice to keep the program at all, with some going as far as to say Overwatch did so to guarantee the world would need them again in the future. However, most experts in the field supported the Temple's construction, as heavy monitoring of the facility ensured that no scraps of its code felt into the wrong hands, as well as allowing them to compare remaining Omnic threats with Anubis, in case it's possible to trace it back as its source. Not only that, but the facility allowed experts to study the AI and find out what exactly went wrong with it, hopefully preventing something like this from ever happening again. A deterrent from another ungodly apocalypse.

The Crisis left ruined cities all across the globe, and in places like Toronto, it was a matter of months before the weather became lethal. Without sufficient manpower, he city wouldn't be habitable by winter, and unable to wait for Overwatch to show up, Mayor Sabella Charon and engineer Malik Wilcox would have to figure out a way to save the city. In the end, no matter how they looked at it, Humans alone wouldn't be able to pull it off in time for winter, so in desperation, they decided to ask the awakened Omnics for help.

They offered the Omnics employment and shelter, as well as access to the resources needed in exchange for aiding construction crews, marking the first recorded instance of Omnics being willfully employed as people rather than tools. At the time, laws on Omnic labor were not set, and the subject was enough to kill both Charon and Wilcox's careers. When the secret came out, Wilcox was arrested and sent to a federal prison, but by the next winter his sentence would be commuted, as Toronto resolved they would need the Omnics again to make it through another winter. While many were suspicious at first, the rebuilding of Toronto proved coexistence was possible and would mark the beginning of the Omnic Rights movement. Still, not everyone was as willing to change. An anti-Omnic terrorist group going by Ontario United will begin to show up across the province, leading to Canadian Forces led by Sojourn to begin a systematic take-down. Sojourn would go on to become a major Omnic rights advocate, and delay her recruitment into Overwatch until her home was safe for Humans and Omnics alike.

Following the Crisis, Adawe was committed to fully focus on her diplomatic duties. She was a strong advocate for peace between humans and the newly sentient Omnics, and called for peace talks between world governments and the emerging leadership figures amongst Omnics. Soon after the groundwork had been laid in the UN for peace negotiations, she announced she would step down as Overwatch's Strike Commander, ready to return to her home of Nigeria, where she planned to focus her efforts on the future of her Nation, for both Humans and Omnics.  Her successor in terms of leadership would be Director William Petras, on behalf of the UN's new international judicial branch, the International Justice Commission, or IJC.

One year after her leave, she would begin the construction of what would one day become the city of Numbani, a place built from the ground up for Omnics and Humans to coexist as equals, with infrastructure designed to cater to Omnic needs with the same level of attention as human needs. The city of Harmony would become Adawe's biggest legacy and serve as an example to the world of what both humanity and Omnic kind could do when they worked in unity.

The Crisis had destroyed many homes, but once it ended, not many expected the return of some old faces. Wandering Omnics, newly awakened would often choose to attempt and return to their old lives, integrating into human society as much as possible, and while this was often not as straightforward as it could be, one case stood out.

The heir to the Arbalest empire, Ashe. Had lived a cold childhood. Parents are always busy with their meetings, making little time for their daughter. Fellow students staying away due to her status. The girl grew up to become a troublemaker, but there was at least one thing in her life she appreciated. The family's bouncer, Unit B.O.B. had stayed by her side for as long as she could remember, serving as the only real company she ever had. When the crisis began, B.O.B. vanished not long after. The girl refused to eat, and yelled to be left alone. Young Ashe blamed herself for her friend leaving her, and while her family went through the Crisis unscathed, she was lonelier than ever, convinced she would never see her one and only friend again.

Around two years later, B.O.B. had returned to the Lead Rose manor, forever changed. While the girl was overjoyed to see her, and the Omnic reciprocated, she could tell he was different, even if she never fully understood what had happened.

With Adawe's departure, Jack Morrison was chosen to lead, acting as Strike commander. While many expected Reyes to take the position, and even react negatively to the news, it turns out that he had personally recommended Morrison for the role. The truth is that Reyes wished for a different position, one that wouldn't have him see the weight of the UN's judgment and respective branch on his every action, and under Morrison he would get his wish, as he would get to coordinate a small team for covert operations.

Under Morrison's command, Overwatch was set to help rebuild the world, and as a statement of their newfound purpose, the first new addition to the Strike team since the Crisis ended would be announced. Emre Sarioglu, a tactical genius from Turkey who had grown in notoriety for both his military prowess, and his innate ability to build connections with everyone he worked for. While the rest of the Strike team often seemed untouchable, mighty and superhuman, Emre was just a regular guy, who always kept fighting a good fight, and inspiring others to do the same. He would go on to become an invaluable asset and a great middle man between the Strike team and the supporting staff across all of Overwatch's divisions, later including Search and Rescue.

name.target: 行动 白色 穹顶

description.source:
Not so long after Sarioglu's recruitment, he would be deployed in Istabul for Operation White Dome. The team led by Ana Amari were meant to quell a pocket of hostile Anubis loyal Omnics. Neither Reyes or Morrison participated. As a way to show the world, Overwatch had the resources to match curated teams for different missions, but this ultimately put extra pressure on the Strike team, as they would be ambushed and take heavy fire that resulted in Lindholm being critically injured, causing him to lose both an arm and an eye. Wilhelm sustained lesser injuries while trying to stabilize Torbjörn.

The mission was a success, but it highlighted that the Strike team was in need of more recruits, and with the blessing of the UN, Morrison began expansion across the entire organization.

name.target: 布丽吉塔·林德霍姆出生

description.source: On September 22nd of 2053, Brigitte Lindholm was born. The youngest of Torbjörn and Ingrid's children. Following Operation White Dome, Reinhardt saw to Lindholm's recovery at the hospital. The grumpy old man grew frustrated by his insistence, so he proposed that if he left him alone, he would allow him to name his soon-to-be-born daughter. Reinhardt agreed, choosing the name Brigitte. The pair would grow close following the mission, and Lindholm would ultimately choose Wilhelm as the child's godfather, making him part of the family.

After the crisis, most Omnium factories remained mostly intact, quarantined from Anubis' grasp, so most governors elected to keep the facilities around for study and potentially to find a better use for them. Some countries instead chose to leave them untouched, to serve as cultural landmarks of Omnic culture, though even among Omnics this idea was heavily debated with mixed results. In reality, there was a bigger reason why the Omniums remained standing after the Crisis, and that was the dangerous fusion reactors deep in their core.

In Australia, the government chose to lend the Outback Omnium and  the surrounding land to the Omnics, as a peace offering. But in doing so, this displaced many indigenous residents, rural communities, solar farmers and survivalists who fought hard during the crisis to keep their homes. Their protests over the decision would go unheard, and lead to the creation of the Australian Liberation Front, an extremist group that sought the complete removal of the Omnic presence from their nation. The ALF grew quickly and caught Overwatch's eyes, but while they monitored them closely, what happened next took everyone by surprise.

Members of the ALF manage to break into the Omnium and, in their attempt to seize it, sabotage the fusion core, resulting in a nuclear explosion visible throughout the entirety of Australia, turning the Outback into an irritated wasteland and decimating the Omnic population beyond repair, leaving the survivors to turn feral from the harsh conditions of the Outback. The ALF settled themselves in the ruins of the Omnium, and established an unofficial Monarchy in what would become Junkertown. Overwatch was about to intervene when the government determined the situation to be a lost cause and a public relations nightmare. Overwatch stood down, and the Junkers remained, though closely monitored, living miserable lives in an apocalypse of their own making.

As Overwatch expanded its personnel, they found themselves in need for more bases of operations. The solution became the Watchpoint system, massive specialized facilities all across the world that would not only allow Overwatch to focus its dedicated personnel into a single place, but also increase their influence and ease of action in many different countries. Plenty of criticism rose from the UN, with many thinking it was an overreach, but the approval rates were overwhelming, as after all, who wouldn't want superheroes living in their neighborhood? With the rise of Omnic violence, the many cities in need of humanitarian aid and rebuilding efforts being halted by lack of manpower, Overwatch's help was welcomed all around the globe.

Acquiring permission for building the Watchpoints was a political battle of its own, but some of them came from resources shared from within. The Martins had been given a small military outpost and research lab on the Strait of Gibraltar following their support of Spain during the Crisis. Once the war was over, the base went unused, so they decided to donate the outpost to become the very first Watchpoint. Many bases were built for specialized purposes:

Gibraltar got turned into an Orbital Launch site.
Grand Mesa, a weapons development facility. 
Kerguelen, reserved for biological studies. 
Xining, focused on social analysis and Omnic integration. 
Then next was the maximum security prison at Grímsvötn. 
In addition to the Watchpoints, Overwatch also established headquarters in Zurich, establishing the beginning of a new hopeful era for humanity.

While Morrison had his hands full, expanding across the globe, Reyes was beginning to set up his Blackwatch Division, a small team for covert operations that would allow him to pursue justice outside red tape and protocol. 

Gérard Lacroix, from the administrative and diplomatic division, would come in to fill the role as Reyes's primary partner. A Parisian diplomat with extensive intelligence work, which quickly drew him into Reyes's orbit. Together, Reyes and Lacroix would prove the merits of Blackwatch and quickly begin a take-down campaign on crime and violence across the world, often using tactics outside of protocol and documentation.

From the outside, the world saw Overwatch as untouchable heroes at this point in time. However, the reality was that they were still human, and taking on Overwatch was just one aspect of their larger lives. Most of the Strike team had families of their own, Ana finally had time to care for her young Fareeha, the Lindholms were expecting yet another baby into the family, and Gabriel had just had his first son with Martina Reyes, his wife that he met while in Mexico.

Jack himself was in a relationship with a long-time partner of his when he got promoted to Strike Commander. Vincent remained supportive of Jack through his years in the military, but grew cautious during the Crisis when Jack brought up the idea of the Soldier Enhancement Program, and later on Overwatch.

Vincent was there for Jack when he needed it most, but he himself wished to settle down as he grew older, while Jack continued to step up and fill increasingly bigger shoes for the sake of the world. Becoming Strike Commander left Jack with very little time for love, and soon after, during a visit to London, the two parted ways. Jack would often question his choice. While everyone around him got to have a family, he dedicated his entire life to Overwatch. Continuing Adawe's legacy and ensuring the organization earned it's place in a post-crisis world became Jack's calling, and while he oftentimes wished to settle, every soldier needs a cause, and his was shaping the world into a better place.

Following the Omnic Crisis, most SEP subjects chose to lie low and fade into private lives, Soldier 00 included. Kendra Banks would meet a Virginian park ranger, James Turner, while she was off the grid. They settled down in the secluded Appalachian mountains and soon enough they would have a kid. On April 17th of 2054, Sierra Turner Woods is born.

Sierra was unknowingly the daughter of a super soldier, and seemingly inherited her mother's gifts. Sadly, however, this soon enough would put a target on both of their backs.

The newly awakened Omnics found themselves in a cold, hostage world. Many were persecuted if not outright hunted and killed, yet on top of it all, most ended up questioning the reason for their existance. How did they cope with being brought to life in such dire conditions? These Omnics traveled the world looking for answers, just like Aurora once did, and it wouldn't be long before they began following her path.

A cult of travelers led by Tekhartha Mondatta, who dedicated his life to studying Aurora's life, trying to gather a complete picture to truly understand her choice, and his place in the world. His journey took the Omnics to Suravasa, where they would choose to abandon the secular world, and begin Aurora's pilgrimage into the Nepalese Himalayas, to honor her memory. Their journey would take the monks to the ruins of a monastery, Aurora's resting place, where she had finally found enlightenment. In there laid the Iris, a metaphysical anomaly formed as a result of the Awakening pulse. The Monks would mark the start of the Shambali religion, studying the Iris, harnessing its energy in hand-crafted orbs to use for meditation, and living under the ideal that unity and coexistence between Humans and Omnics was achievable, as the way they saw it, they are all one within the Iris.

The Shambali faith would quickly grow across the Omnic communities of the world and be a key factor in the Omnic rights movement. Dr. Mina Liao herself would often visit the Monastery, both for study of the Iris, and to organize meetings amongst leaders, like Mondatta, as she had grown to be quite the prominent Omnic right activist following the Awakening. The monks naturally welcomed her warmly, and shared her cause.

As politics settled among the chaos of the Junkers, King Mason Howl would be crowned the leader of the city. Howl was a ruthless self-centered king who quickly turned his back against his people when questioned. The Stones were a family of settlers that ran town watch and negotiated trade, but one day the King decided to vanish the entire family.

Living in the wasteland, young Dez Stone would quickly learn to fight to survive, as one by one every member of her family perished to the wasteland. The feral Omnics lurking in the Outback proved fatal.

Like many others around the world, young Angela Zeigler had lost her parents to the Crisis, while they volunteered at a local hospital. This traumatic event would serve to keep her focus on her studies. The girl would go on to become one of the youngest graduates of the medical program at the University of Zurich and quickly rose up to be quite the name in the scientific world, meeting brilliant minds like Siebren de Kuiper while at school. She would later enroll at Chalmers University in Gothenburg, where she focused on nanobiology and developed several breakthroughs in the field and its uses in medicinal science.

Angela had visited Torbjörn at the hospital following his injury during Operation White Dome, as her family were close friends with the Linholms. During the visit, he was so impressed by her papers on nanobiotics that he sent a recommendation to Morrison to fund her schooling and offer monetary support. On Linholm's advice, Angela had also begun volunteering for Overwatch's medical staff, becoming one of very few civilians allowed to tour Watchpoints. With their funding and guidance, Zeigler was a brilliant mind with an even brighter future lying ahead of her.

On November 11th of 2054, Findlay Docherty was born to veterans of the Omnic Crisis. He grew up poor in a world that was still adjusting after the war, surrounded by stories of violence and a system that kept failing the people. The crisis had taken a heavy toll on his parents, causing hardship and arguments. His mother died when he was only four, and his father became absent and unkind, leaving Findlay to fend for himself.

Years of neglect led Ashe to constantly breaking the law, and gaining a reputation with the authorities. On one occasion, she was arrested for armed assault inspired by it being in self-defense. While spending time in jail, waiting to be bailed out, she met Cole Cassidy in the cell block. Like many others around the area, he was employed by nearby megafarms after they lost their Omnic staff. The farms were filled with refugees during the war, and eventually they came to be used for cheap labor. Cass had ended up locked after a brawl broke out among the farmhands. Ashe came to envy her new friend, for the freedom he had as a ruffian, drifting away without having to answer to anybody.

After the bailout, Ashe was greeted by disapproving parents on a holoscreen, not even trying to listen to her side of the story. They had grown tired of her actions and decided that once she turned 18, they would cut off from the family and its finances. In a fit of anger, Ashe plotted how to get back at her family for how they treated her, and realized selling Arbalest goods to the black market would be the best way to bite back, but in order to do so she needed to pull a heist. Ashe and B.O.B would then drive by the Ace Valentine megafarm to pick up Cassidy, and together they started to assemble a team to steal from the Arbalest facilities her family controlled. A fellow farmhand of Cass, Julian and a hired hacker going by Frankie would join their ranks, forming the start of the Deadlock Rebels.

A notable trend across the world following the Crisis was the return to classical architecture. As many cities had been leveled by the war, many of them needed to rebuild from the ground up, changing greatly from how they used to look years prior. With the construction of the Temple of Anubis, Cairo gained a new Pyramid. As Lumérico built power plants across Mexico, their architecture was inspired by Aztec and Mayan architecture. And this trend can be seen across the world on many other sites. In Greece, a small Aegean island renamed itself to Illios and built a giant statue on the nearby coast, echoing stories of the Colossus of Rhodes.

But perhaps none of these rebuilt structures stands out more than the Colosseo Gladiatori. Italy had rebuilt the Colosseum and reopened it for the masses. The newly  formed Gladiator games were a pageant that became a cultural touchstone of Rome in the wake of the crisis. Within the Arena Victoriae of the Colosseo, all sorts of events would be hosted to entertain both the public and the European elite. From one-to-one gladiator matches, to robotic chariot races, mech fights and even stand-offs against machines designed for war, much like those Anubis used in The Crisis.

The Colosseo grew over the years, and the champions of the Arena would quickly become influential figures in Europe too, as the Elites visiting the Colosseo would often sponsor their fights and take in profits from their victories.

While smaller gangs like the Hashimoto were on the rise in Japan, they still had a long way to go if they wished to reach the longevity and status of senior Yakuza. The ancient Shimada clan remained strong even after the crisis. A family of criminals that had a choke-hold over Tokyo, but unlike many of the rival clans, they had gained the trust and even loyalty of the locals, seeing themselves as rulers and ruled. As such, inspired by their shady nature, the people of the Kanezaka region respected the clan as protectors, and the Shimada in turn kept opposing clans away, preventing them from hurting their people.

A big part of the Shimada's success was owned by the blacksmith Toshiro Yamagami, creator of the Anima blades. Toshiro was a weapon smith in possession of unique avatar technology, capable of imbuing traditional weaponry with an ethereal, malleable energy. These weapons were not only enhanced by the Anima's energy, but with enough discipline, their users would be able to manifest projections spirits at will. Toshiro would serve the clan, designing blades for their family, which in turn used them to suppress the opposition and solidify their cultural position as the rulers of the region.

While the clan forbid Toshiro from making any Anima Avatars after forging dragon blades for the Shimada heirs, Toshiro had one last masterpiece that he kept a secret from the clan. The man had planned to propose to what would be his wife, Asa Kamori, a skilled sword master, daughter to the shrine maiden of the local Fox shrine. To win her mother's heart, Toshiro crafted Ofuda Talismans imbued with Anima technology, which would bring the Fox spirit to life, and assist the old lady in her Miko duties.

A Ravager unit now going by the name of Ramattra had chosen to follow Mondatta, lost in grief by the suffering of his people, seeking a sense of purpose and hope of one day being able to cohexist with humans. During his time with the Shambali he would still take time to protest for Omnic equality, and many would embrace his message. A lost soul going by Zenyatta approached him seeking guidance, and Ramattra seing hims as a spiritual equal, invited him to join him at the monastery, as he hoped together they could find a sense of purpose and harmony amidst conflict. 

For years, Zenyatta and Ramattra studied and trained together, often arguing over their different views, while still being able to balance each other in harmony. They would regularly gaze at the stars together, wondering just how many Omnics out there might be doing the same, but in reality, Ramattra would soon learn that many were not looking up at all. While the Shambali were blessed with clarity and a sense of purpose, many Omnics across the world were fully submitted to their reality, and even those who were not still suffered without being able to do much to improve their lives. Ramattra would make it his life's mission to guide these Omnics into seeking justice, but his views would often clash with the other monks who merely sought coexistence.

As the group expanded their turf with larger, riskier operations, they would often come into conflict with other gang territories, and loyalties would be put into question. The gang came to work with many larger groups before, some of which later became enemies, such as the Diamondbacks. During one of their confrontations, Julian would end up betraying the group, getting Cassidy captured. The leader of the Diamondbacks set his terms for release, that Ashe was to cease all activities, as she had gotten greedy and crossed into their turfm but Ashe would not 

Not long after, the rest of the gang put together a plan to rescue him, when they came across Benito Sanchez, the second in command of the Diamondbacks and a close friend of Frankie’s. Bez had decided to defect after personal grievances with the leadership, and he knew others felt the same. With Bez's help from the inside, Ashe and Frankie were able to rescue Cassidy and overthrow the Diamondbacks leadership out of their den. The remainder of the gang members would choose to follow their new leader, as Ashe slowly began to form a name for herself in the New West. The Diamondbacks hideout, known as the Deadlock Gorge, would become their new base of operations, and the place where Ashe, Cassidy, Bez and Frankie decided to officiate the founding of the Deadlock Rebels, in honor to their new home.

Overwatch aided in the rebuilding efforts all around the world. In the words of Torbjörn himself, they were "The Janitors of the Apocalypse", and their efforts became invaluable in getting the world back together. The engineering team was working on repairing the Canadian pipeline system when a massive storm struck, causing much of British Columbia to flood all the way down to Seattle.

Overwatch's quick response allowed the displaced locals to survive the disaster, as both a field team and support staff were sent to assist in the evacuation of both people and wildlife. Thanks to Overwatch the situation was dealt with swiftly and with minimal losses. Once the water receded, Amari coordinated with local authorities to distribute resources with the refugees, while Lindholm's team began the construction of a series of Dams and bridges across the West Coast, to reroute water out to the sea.

The Vancouver Flood response made headlines and many proved Overwatch's worth in a post-crisis world, showing that, in spite of their superhuman capabilities, they were also more than willing to come down and help with the dirty work.

On August 8th of 2056, Ye Anran was born. Raised to be the perfect prodigy, aspiring to transcend the sky-high expectations set by her parents, both of them Fire College graduates of Wuxing that commanded operations during the Crisis. At the age of three, they both personally trained her in academic and martial arts, enrolling her in competitive Wushu-taolu and classical dance classes as she grew older. Anran persevered through the pressure, training through injuries and breaking records every year, never finishing off the podium.

The rise of Gang violence across the American Southwest quickly became a topic of interest for Overwatch, and when needed, they would address these gangs individually by dispatching agents, and later send the engineering teams for repairs. Among the gangs, the rising threat of the Deadlock Rebels became of special concern to Reyes. The leader, Calamity Ashe was fast at forming alliances with other rival gangs, and had created a stranglehold on the region. Reyes would take a small team of troops to investigate the situation personally. After gathering intelligence on the gang, a massive operation to take down the Rebels was put into action.

Cole Cassidy, a founding member of the gang, would create a distraction that resulted in his arrest, but allowed the rest of the leadership to escape. Ashe, Frankie and Bez would continue to search for him in hopes of rescue, but they did not know that it was too late for that, as Cassidy had been taken by Overwatch, not as a prisoner but as a willing recruit.

After the Deadlock raid, Reyes surprised everyone when he brought their prisoner alongside him. Gabriel saw talent in Cassidy, notin his guts, loyalty and excellent marksmanship for someone his age. With enough guidance he could turn his life around, and Reyes believed it would be a waste to lock him up without a second change.

Thus he gave him the choice, to either rot in jail for years, or to come with him as his student, and make better use of his skill as an Overwatch agent. While many saw his inclusion as conscription of a minor, he seemed pleased with the arrangement and quickly proved himself to be an efficient asset. He would be placed under Ana's wing to hone his skills with the gun, and soon after, he would join Reyes in the Blackwatch division. As Reyes understudy, Cass would often think back of Deadlock, assuming he did the right thing because his gang never came  to his rescue, convincing himself that this path meant he was better than them, clueless of the fact that his old partners were still desperately trying to save him by the time he agreed to join Reyes. Still, Cassidy made for a great addition to the Strike team and a valuable asset for Reyes' division.

On April 9th of 2057, Mizuki Kawano was born in Fukuoka, under the shadow of misfortune. Ever since he was a baby, his family had been surrounded by unexplained tragedy. His grandparents suddenly lost to unnatural causes, and years later his mom would drown in a freak accident. His father, quite the superstitious man, was quick to assume the bloodline must have been cursed, and from there Mizuki's life would only continue to go downhill. As the mental state of his dad worsened, he ingrained the idea of a curse in the poor kid's head, telling him tales of all the malevolent spirits that haunted the family ever since he was born.

In the years that followed the Crisis, Vishkar would quickly rise into a global powerhouse. Having helped the Indian government during the war, hard light technology advanced greatly in the span of a few years, and with the world left in ruins, the company saw it as a great chance to spearhead the reparations. But in spite of their power, they had far too few hands. Most of the early architects had either left the company years ago or died during the Crisis. Hard light technology was quite complex, and it required years of training to master, but in looking for solutions to their shortage of staff, Vishkar would make the controversial decision to turn to the hundreds of orphans left by the crisis.

With the approval of a desperate government, Vishkar would open the Architect Academy, a school meant to pipeline kids across the nation into becoming the architects of the future. Staffed with the best professionals in the country and providing housing and education to any orphan they could find. To pay for their education, the students would merely be required to complete a five-year tour of duty for the company following their graduation day, which would in most cases set them off for success and open doors within the corporation. While initially met with outcry about the coercing of minors, the Academy was a success in the long run, which led to many wealthy families across the globe sending their children to the Academy, with fully paid tuition to avoid the post-graduation requirements. It is here where Satya Vaswani and Niran Pruksamanee first crossed paths, the son of a wealthy family and a girl plucked out of poverty, spending their student days as roommates and quickly gaining notoriety amongst their peers for their unique perspective and techniques.

The world needed to relearn how to take care of itself, and while many believed blatant climate change on the advent of new technologies over the last couple of decades, the true cause was not really known to science even after years of research and investment in how to counteract it. Unexplained anomalies in the atmosphere have begun to present themselves across the world, many of them relating to the formation of super storms, and the effects of these abnormal pockets in the environment could be catastrophic if left unchecked.

It was around this time that a young Dr. Mei-Ling Zhou finished her college degree as a climatologist, specializing in studying these weather phenomena, determined to fight for a better future. Dr. Zhou's research quickly became notorious in the environmentalist community as she introduced many cutting-edge innovations in climate manipulation that were able to protect areas in risk from Asia and around the world. 

During her time in grad school, Mei's research would allow her to meet many people across multiple scientific fields, such as her close friend, Jiayi Teo, who had family working at Wuxing University's Metal College and aimed at joining Lucheng Interstellar. But it also made Mei run into many anti-intellectual and obstinate persons who fought against the data even after years worth of proof of the worsening climate worldwide. These friendly connections however, eventually allowed her to join the biosphere department of Overwatch's new ecological initiative: The Ecopoint Program.

On June 22th of 2057, Hana Song was born in Busan. Her father was a former professional gamer during his youth and he would bond with his daughter through the hobby, playing early century classics like StarCraft with her, which quickly made it apparent Hana had excellent skills, just like her father.

Hana would grow up to be a heavily competitive woman, staying up late with her childhood friend Dae-Hyun to work on his hover bike. She would often race and on one occasion she managed to win, at the cost of the bike and nearly taking her own life due to the reactor overloading.

With God Programs, more specifically Anubis, gone, the responsibility of their duties fell back on humanity once more, and while in a lot of cases their functionality was rerouted or essentially taken over by other organizations, in some cases, such as environmental duties, they started to become heavily neglected. Anubis was meant to be used for ecological preservation, and yet with most infrastructure lost, the whole left by the program began to become apparent to Hector and Claudio. The Martins were long time environmentalist advocates, and they believed that Overwatch could be used to improve the world, so they took a proposal to Morrison and the UN to create a specialized Watchpoint branch. 

The Ecopoint Program would create stations staffed with Overwatch's scientific leads in critical locations across the globe, where they could monitor ongoing abnormalities in nature and aid in global efforts for preservation of the environment. In spite of a wave of nationalism and distrust for Overwatch presence hitting many countries over the years, the Ecopoints were quite a welcomed proposal, as the Martins were highly respected names in the international communities they worked with, and the benefits of scientifically-oriented bases were far more self-evident than the more generalist and often military nature of Watchpoints. With the approval of the program, other big names like Mui and Namuaca quickly joined, adding further credibility to the initiative. In the end, seven initial bases were approved, with more coming later.

Biosphere (Green) Ecopoints:
- Ecopoint: Antartica focused on monitoring the impacts of climate change and pursuing methods of recovery of both the atmosphere and the ice caps, as well as studying strange fluctuations found around the Peninsula. 
- Ecopoint: Connemara focused on the restoration of Irish boglands, later on collaborating with Russian scientists to aid in revitalizing the Siberian lowlands. 
- Ecopoint: Tarapoto, deep within the Colombian Amazon, was built to study the many ecosystems of the area. 
- Ecopoint: Osa in Costa Rica would focus on the recovery of reptiles and amphibians of the Corcovado cloud forest, seen as a bellwether of the rest of the natural world, focusing primarily on antifungals and biological solutions to waste treatment. 

Hydrosphere (Blue) Ecopoints:
- Samoa would receive a base within one of the active volcanoes, to focus on seismic monitoring and geothermal research, detecting multiple major earthquakes in the region and saving countless lives. 
- Ecopoint: Zealandia off the coast of New Zeland would exist in response to the Australian fall-out zone, focusing on filtering radiation and aiding in the recovery of Oceania following the ALF's attack. 
- And lastly, Ecopoint: Monterrey, a submarine base off the shore of California, meant to research marine life and follow protocols originally proposed by Leon Honisch to aid in the recovery of many species. The program was overall seen as one of Overwatch's most clean-cut successes and net positives to society at large, and a great example of the good they could do for the world

On July 7th of 2057, Kiriko Kamori is born into the Yamagami blades, spending her childhood surrounded by powerful figures of all kinds, among her parents, stemmed figures in the art of the blade and the craft, her grandmother, the local Shrine Maiden, and the shadow of the Shimada Clan, and the tales of their relationship with the city.

Kiriko grew to be a very idealistic, impressionable kid who did not quite fully understand the reality of her situation, of the clan brawls that plagued Kanezaka, and the role her family played in endorsing them, but despite of that, her idealistic self and the teachings of her grandma's faith pushed her to help others and follow her own path.

As Overwatch expanded and aided the world heal, they sought to form good relationships with other peacekeeping operations around the globe, particularly those that didnt make a part of the original recruitment process during the Crisis. Just like how Doomfist chose to protect his own home over joining Overwatch, many other groups like the Inti Warriors of Peru or the Caribbean Coaliton rejected Adawe's proposal, oftne due to intense regional pressure and concerns joining Overwatch would leave their home undefended. Morrison outreach groups all over the world, from Peru to Polynesia, Jordan and Bangladesh to try and collaborate in the post-Crisis landscape, but one of these partners proved to be closer than the rest.

The Caribbean Coaltion remained strong even as the Crisis ended, but it quickly fueled concerns among the governments of the Caribbean and Latin America that the alliance defied their sovereignty. This was part of a global wave of nationalism following the Crisis, as many nations, struck by years of violence and destruction, chose to spend resources inward. The Coaltion defied that mindset, and understood that without sharing their resources in these dire times the Caribbean would never bounce back. The Concerned Nations requested Overwatch to intervene and dismantle the rouge Coalition at once, but to everyone's surprise, Commander Morrison chose to aid the Coalition's efforts instead, deploying the strike team and much of the medical crew, including Angela Ziegler herself. To the people of the Caribbean, Overwatch were more than welcome, and a wave of recruitments soon followed, but the governments soon would come to resent this response and in the years to follow they would be less inclined to speak positively of Overwatch.

During this period, a young orphan, Jean-Baptiste Augustin, would await the day he could enlist into Overwatch, hoping he could be a medic alongside his heroes. However, as the governments resisted their presence, Overwatch recruitment would never come to Haiti, so without many other options to survive, Baptiste chose to join the military, working as a combat medic for the Caribbean Coalition, hoping one day he could be like the heroes from the posters.

The City of Harmony, Numbani would see ongoing expansion for years following Adawe's departure, to great success and reception worldwide. The City State emerged in Nigeria under Adawe's vision, to build a place for people of all kinds, human and Omnics, to live in unity. In order to achieve this, she collaborated with an Omnic task force that would pioneer what a truly Omnic-inclusive environment looked like, from tailored housing that accommodated their needs instead of human ones, lacking kitchens and instead hosting things like oiling gear. Clinics that performed maintenance and repair of crisis wounds, psychological services to help with the trauma that followed the war and the trouble of consciousness, as well as spiritual centers for study of philosophy and theology, especially with the rising Shambali faith. A lot of focus was also placed on giving Omnics resources to find jobs outside their pre-Crisis designation, letting them pursue their own dreams outside human expectations and design. 

The push for Omnic infrastructure would lead to heavy investment in intellectual and artistic enrichment, which would lead to a thriving sense of pride and community for the arts in the city. A lot of the principles used when building Numbani were modeled after the infrastructure and plans of the new Toronto, following their own Omnic Integration. By the time the city was finished, it had proved to the world that coexistence was possible, and the city became a beacon of hope for Omnic allies around the globe. The day the last brick was laid would be declared Unity Day, and celebrated as a holiday in the city to mark the huge accomplishment of Omnic and Human Collaboration. Shortly after the inauguration, Adawe passed away, and was mourned by the people across the entire city, and celebrated as a Nigerian hero, not unlike Adhabu Ngumi, the first Doomfist.

Ana's relationship with her family had been messy since the beginning. She had married after being surprised by a little girl from a relatively casual relationship, and during the Crisis both her and Sam had their hands too full to raise a child.

Fareeha spent most of her youth in Canada with her father, but Ana would always try to make time for her daughter. Outside Overwatch, Ana went on to train the next generation of the Egyptian Army, and Fareeha, her biggest admirer, would too receive personal classes from her mother, many people questioned her choices, of training military personnel while also being part of an organization that promoted peace, but Amari ignored them, lacking the idealism  to think humanity could ever move pass war.

Fareeha would also be a regular visitor to Overwatch bases and became familiar with many of the members of the strike team, developing a kinship with Cassidy and Angela. In spite of this, Ana always hoped her daughter would go on to live a different life, one free of fighting. Fareeha on the other hand, wished to one day join her mother in Overwatch, which led to drawn-out arguments between the two, which got so bad Fareeha eventually dropped the subject.

While the US publicly seemed content with SEP soldiers vanishing into obscuring, something about Soldier: 00 appears to be different. Kendra Banks had been the first candidate for the Soldier Enhancement Program, and much like the rest of Project Naughton, her service was heavily redacted and poorly documented. What little is known suggests she defected from the program shortly after her procedure and has been in hiding ever since. Kendra hoped living in Appalachia would keep her and her family hidden, but only a year after her daughter Sierra was born, Kendra would be found.

Kendra Banks, now going by Kendra Woods, fled into the night and took Sierra with her, as government agents raided their house asking questions about Project Naughton to her husband, James Turner. Ever since that day, Sierra has lived on the run, bouncing from one school to another, completely unaware of her mother's past. Each time they were found, they would have to move out quickly, and to calm little Sierra down, Kendra knew how to make a game out of evacuation and protocol.

Through it all, Sierra lived a relatively normal life. While she was always the new kid and had little to no friends due to this, she always placed at the top of her class and demonstrated innate physical skills and sharp thinking. While she always attributed this to her mother's teachings, little did she know one of Doctor Naughton's main hypothesis with the Soldier Enhancement Program, was the possibility of children inheriting the modifications.

The Lindholms were a family filled with bright minds. Both parents were respected figures in the engineering and scientific communities at large, and their children grew up to be successful in many fields, from art to medicine. It was only natural that the creative Lindholm spark would come to little Brigitte as well. Brigitte was the first of Torbjörn's kids to show interest in engineering. Following her father's footsteps by tinkering in his workshop, and honing on her skills. Her aptitude mirrored her father's, but she was primarily interested in fabricating armor and defensive systems.

From an early age, Brigitte's ingenuity would get her in trouble, crafting contraptions like ladder boots to get away with stealing cookies from the top shelves. As the youngest of four, she found herself fighting with her siblings to get food before they devoured it all, so she created a lightweight jetpack to help her out pace them, but she only got to use it once before Ingrid banned inventions in the kitchen. She would later attempt to build other jetpacks and armor for her cat Mitzi, before that also got her in trouble.

 As her godfather, and a regular guest at the Lindholm household, Reinhardt would play an instrumental role in Brigitte's life. She grew up listening to Reinhardt's chivalry stories when he paid them a visit, and they inspired a strong sense of justice and discipline in her, which helped shape her own trajectory as a defensive engineer later in life.

With the Crisis, the world had lost faith in Artificial Intelligence all together. Between heavy tensions with Omnics growing worldwide and the repurposing, if not outright, shutdown of God programs worldwide, the planet was ready to move on from AI, but Mina Liao was eager to revitalize the world's trust in her field. Years after the Crisis, Dr. Liao would reveal her first major project under Overwatch, the Athena artificial intelligence system.

In spite of taking the name of a deity, Athena was not a full god program in the traditional sense. In spite of the limited scope of the program's intelligence, Athena was able to optimize missions, providing detailed briefings and projected areas of potential conflict, way before any agents received intel on a task. The assistant proved successful in many missions and paved the road for further projects under Liao's guidance, albeit without truly removing safe lines around her research.

Liao still grieved the loss of Aurora as her creator. In her eyes, the Omnics were Aurora's legacy, and she hoped the for equality between Humans and Omnics could one day be achieved. While she was not often a public speaker, her writings and interviews quickly positioned her as a powerful ally to the rising Omnic rights movement, for which she later joined in a handful of rallies and marches.

Years after the end of the Crisis a Robotic Colossus emerged from the East China Sea, immediately making its advance towards South Korea and setting off Overwatch's alarms. Morrison recalled all agent fields and directed every resource they had towards the machine. The battle against the colossus was unlike any other; The robot dwarfed even the largest Crisis-era Titan units. By the time Overwatch and the Korean army, the Colossus was miles offshore, intercepting shipping vessels and destroying them without hesitation. Overwatch, not used to fighting in water, struggled to contain the beast and stop the violence, but in the end the Colossus was beaten back and presumably destroyed.

Some strike team members welcomed the battle as a chance to return to what they did best, while for many others this was far more concerning. Liao noticed the warbot's design felt unusual to her, so she requested a long-term field assignment to South Korea to study the remains, and while Korea had shown significant push back at the idea of establishing a Watchpoint: in the country, they at least aided Liao by providing her with recovered pieces for Analysis. The primary concern was for some hostile group to have access to an unknown Omnium and use it to attack enemy nations. For the time being, it appeared there would be no way to find out what happened, and Liao's research would not yield any results for months. The beast would be known as the Gwishin, a type of spirit curse to roam the earth in Korean folklore, a fitting name for a lingering ghost of the Omnic Crisis.

Seeing as Korea would not allow the construction of an base, Overwatch would establish Watchpoint: Xining in China. Originally planed as a Busan base before Korea's rejection, the base  would focus on analyzing world politics and inter personal patterns, as well as working towards Omnic Integration and Crisis recovery of communities around Asia. However te base would also act as Overwatch's nearest deployment in case of another Gwishin attack.

The war hero had been buried with his weapon, and celebrated across the nation, until one day a man appeared in Numbani wielding an upgraded gauntlet, stolen from the grave. Akinjide Adeyemi, a warmonger who profiteered from constant raids in the city, declaring it a blight upon Nigeria and swearing to destroy it. Known as the Scourge of Numbani, between the gauntlet and a small militia distributed across Africa he became, this second Doomfist would terrorize the city for nearly twelve years, and since Overwatch lacked jurisdiction in Numbani, they were unable to intervene from the inside, but they found ways around it. 

While Scouting for Ecopoint: locations, many other Watchpoints would get approved, such as Xining and Grimsvotn, but during this process Ana Amari noted that among the many bases, Overwatch had a shamefully thin presence around Central Africa, and under her guidance, Watchpoint: Kisangani got approved.
